answer: Yes, American Express successfully retained and grew its card member base during 2022. Total cards-in-force increased to 133.3 million as of December 31, 2022, compared to 121.7 million at the end of 2021, representing a 10 percent increase. Basic cards-in-force also rose from 100.7 million in 2021 to 111.5 million in 2022.
rationale: The statistics in Table 5 (Selected Card-Related Statistical Information) show that total cards-in-force and basic cards-in-force both increased significantly from 2021 to 2022, demonstrating that American Express not only retained existing card members but also grew its card base.
